description: This file defines a Dart API client for a Flutter application, providing mechanisms for handling authentication tokens, making HTTP requests, error handling, and specific methods for interacting with backend endpoints such as books, users, and analytics. It includes classes for wrapping API responses, managing session state, and performing authenticated requests with token refresh support.

classes.name: ApiSafeResult
classes.description: A wrapper class for the result of API calls, indicating success status, HTTP status code, data payload, and error message.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A flexible client for backend API interactions with JWT authentication, token refresh, and error handling.

methods.name: accessToken
methods.description: Getter for the current access token.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Getter for the current refresh token.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Getter for the current authenticated user object.

methods.name: set onForceLogout
methods.description: Setter for the callback function to be invoked when the user must be forcibly logged out.

methods.name: _authHeaders
methods.description: Constructs headers including the Authorization Bearer token when available.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with the specified method, path, headers, query parameters, and body, with support for retries on 401 responses.

methods.name: _tryRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to refresh the access token using the refresh token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs authentication with email and password to obtain tokens and user info.

methods.name: loginGoogle
methods.description: Performs authentication via Google ID token to obtain tokens and user info.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets the current session tokens and user info, and persists them.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the session tokens and user info, logging out the user.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks whether a user is currently logged in based on the presence of an access token.

methods.name: listBooks
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of books, with optional search query, requiring authentication.

methods.name: createBook
methods.description: Creates a new book with specified fields, requiring authentication.

methods.name: updateBook
methods.description: Updates a book identified by its ID with new fields, requiring authentication.

methods.name: deleteBook
methods.description: Deletes a book identified by its ID, requiring authentication.

methods.name: fetchAnalytics
methods.description: Fetches analytics summary data from the backend.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users with optional search parameters, read-only, requiring authentication.

methods.name: getPresignedUploadUrl
methods.description: Requests a presigned URL for uploading files or covers, requiring authentication.

methods.name: safeGet
methods.description: Performs a safe GET request that returns an ApiSafeResult or null if offline/disabled.

methods.name: safePost
methods.description: Performs a safe POST request that returns an ApiSafeResult or null if offline/disabled.

methods.name: _decodeMsg
methods.description: Decodes error message strings from JSON response bodies.
